name: PT Niramas Utama Tbk.
summary: PT Niramas Utama Tbk. produces and sells dessert food and beverage products in Indonesia. The company offers products, such as Nata De Coco, jelly, pudding, aloe vera, konnyaku, Confectionery, jelly drinks, Energel, and IM coco drinks. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia. PT Niramas Utama Tbk. is a subsidiary of PT Niramas Utama International.
